subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should this repair implement the canonical issue's additive request-cancellation capability with authoritative pending/effecting/completed state?
rationale: Maintainer intent is required to define the permanent Gateway protocol and the security semantics for when cancellation wins versus when execution is already effecting and cancellation is too late.

options.title: Implement the full lifetime contract
options.body: Add request-level cancellation and server-owned state so timeout, explicit abort, connection close, and post-dispatch cancellation are distinguishable.

options.title: Pause this implementation
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open for a separately designed protocol rather than merging a socket-close-only partial repair.

recommendation.title: Implement the full lifetime contract
recommendation.body: Add request-level cancellation and server-owned state so timeout, explicit abort, connection close, and post-dispatch cancellation are distinguishable.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue records the expected security boundary and preferred repair architecture, and recent history connects this person to the node.invoke path.
